application_questions.question: Seven properties sold in a Ballarat suburb in one week for (in thousands of dollars): $510, 530, 540, 540, 560, 580, 1400$ (where $\$1\,400\,000$ was a heritage acreage estate). Find (a) the median and mean of all $7$ prices, and (b) the new median and new mean when the $\$1\,400\,000$ outlier is removed.
application_questions.answer: (a) Median $= \$540\text{k}$, Mean $= \$665.71\text{k}$; (b) New Median $= \$540\text{k}$ (unchanged!), New Mean $= \$543.33\text{k}$

application_questions.question: Over his first $5$ netball matches, Noah's team scored $42, 38, 45, 51$, and $39$ goals. How many goals must the team score in the $6$th match to achieve a mean of $44$ goals per match across all $6$ matches?

In a Year 8 science cohort, Class 8A ($20$ students) has a mean test score of $76$, and Class 8B ($30$ students) has a mean test score of $81$. Calculate the combined mean score for all $50$ students.

A stem-and-leaf plot of daily commuter cycling times (in minutes, where $2 \mid 5 = 25$) for $9$ trips is: $1 \mid 8, 9$; $2 \mid 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8$; $6 \mid 5$. Find the median, mean, and range of the $9$ trips, and identify the outlier.
application_questions.answer: Outlier $= 65\text{ min}$; Median $= 24\text{ min}$, Mean $= 26.56\text{ min}$ ($\frac{239}{9}$), Range $= 47\text{ min}$

reasoning_questions.question: The mean of $6$ numbers is $15$. When one number is removed, the mean of the remaining $5$ numbers drops to $13$. Find the value of the number that was removed.
Find a set of $4$ positive integers written in ascending order $a \le b \le c \le d$ such that the mode is $5$, the median is $7$, and the mean is $8$. Show each step of your deduction.
